old_caption: The video opens with a wide shot of a snowy landscape under an overcast sky. The ground is blanketed in snow, and sparse bushes dot the terrain. A man stands in the center of the frame, dressed in winter clothing, including a green jacket and sunglasses, suggesting cold weather conditions. He appears to be observing his surroundings or preparing for an activity. As the scene progresses, there is a sudden explosion, creating a visible plume of smoke and debris. The man is no longer visible after frame 13. The camera remains static, capturing the entire event without any noticeable movement or change in angle. The overall atmosphere is one of quiet anticipation followed by a dramatic burst of action.
original_wisa_caption: The video opens with a wide shot of a snowy landscape under an overcast sky. The ground is blanketed in snow, and sparse bushes dot the terrain. A man stands in the center of the frame, dressed in winter clothing, including a green jacket and sunglasses, suggesting cold weather conditions. He appears to be observing his surroundings or preparing for an activity. As the scene progresses, there is a sudden explosion in the distance, sending a plume of smoke and debris into the air. The explosion occurs off-screen but is clearly visible due to the dust cloud it creates. The man remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining his position in the snowy field. The camera remains static, capturing the entire event without any noticeable movement or change in angle. The overall atmosphere is one of quiet anticipation followed by a dramatic burst of action.
caption: A man in a dark hooded jacket, sunglasses, and black gloves stands in a snow-covered field dotted with dry bushes. He faces the camera from the middle ground while the overcast purple sky and distant horizon remain fixed. His posture shifts only slightly, and the foreground bushes do not move across the still frame. The view then changes abruptly to the same empty field, with the man no longer present and the framing unchanged. A brief bright flash appears among the middle-distance bushes before the eruption. A grayish cloud of dust and snow erupts at that exact spot. The plume rises and expands steadily, forming a rounded, billowing column above the impact area. Its base remains at the ground while the upper mass grows taller and wider. The surrounding snowy landscape and bushes stay still as the single cloud continues to drift upward.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
